service.name: x
service.title: X API Posts (curated)
service.description: A deliberately small OpenAPI 3 subset of the X (Twitter) API v2 for one user: identity, tweet lookup, create/quote a Post, and one-shot image upload. This is not the full X API (no v1.1, no chunked video, no DMs, no search, no ads). Official marketplace MCP plugins that only expose read/chat tools cannot publish; this document is the write path the generator can emit. Use a pre-obtained OAuth 2.0 *user* access token (not an app-only bearer). Never put tokens in this file.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Identify the X user this OAuth 2.0 user-context token belongs to. Call this first. App-only (application-only) bearers cannot write and often fail here. Do not send the token as an argument; it is X_API_TOKEN.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read one Post by id. Use this to confirm a publish or to copy the id you will quote / reply to.

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Publish a Post as the authenticated user. Pass text, and optionally quote_tweet_id (quote) or media.media_ids (images from upload_media). Do not send quote_tweet_id and media together — X rejects that pair. To add images under another Post, use reply.in_reply_to_tweet_id. Requires tweet.write. Blocked while X_READ_ONLY=1.

body.description: Post text, optional quote id, optional media ids, optional reply.

CreatePostRequest.description: X requires text and/or media. quote_tweet_id quotes another Post. quote_tweet_id and media are mutually exclusive on this endpoint.

text.description: Post text (280 graphemes for standard Posts).

quote_tweet_id.description: Id of the Post to quote. Mutually exclusive with media. May require an entitled X API plan.

media.description: Attach previously uploaded media ids. Mutually exclusive with quote_tweet_id. Upload images first with upload_media.

reply.description: Reply in-thread instead of quoting. Use this to attach images under another Post when a quote cannot carry media.

in_reply_to_tweet_id.description: Id of the Post being replied to.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Upload one image as base64 JSON (media + media_category=tweet_image). Returns data.id for create_post media.media_ids. No multipart, no local file path, no chunked video. Requires media.write. Blocked while X_READ_ONLY=1.

media.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (OpenAPI format byte). JSON only — no multipart file field. Keep images within X photo size limits.

media_category.description: One-shot upload category. tweet_image for still photos.
